reader_held.why: Quizzed on the noun 'motivation' he gave the adjective متشجع; Amal said no, the thing not the adjective (sheet: incentive / motivation | 7aafez; motive / motiva
Asked for 'all my taxes' he said kul il darayib (all the taxes); Amal said كل ضرايبي (owner ending, no el-) and he repeated kul darayibi.
For 'I am happy' he said basboot (a non-word), then mazboot (wrong word); Amal said No and hinted 'ab-'; he got mabsut, her chat writes mabsoot.
He asked for 'hope' a second time (first at 19:18, A3) and Amal gave بتمنى again - a separate didn't-know moment.
8eir + plural for 'a different country (every year)'; Amal said دولة after his line and he said غير دولة; her chat writes 8eir dawle (sheet: country | Dawle).
For 'I didn't know' he seems to put a past ending on the participle عارف (عارفت); the past is ما عرفت (or ما كنت عارف). Amal did not react; the engine may have
He asked for the noun 'the change'; Amal hinted with the verb إنت غيرت (sheet: you (m) changed | inta 8ayyaret) and he got الـ تغيير; she said أها.
He built 'the red house' with el- only on the adjective; Amal recast البيت الأحمر. Low: it was an example inside a rule question.
Idafa owner left bare; Amal asked 'family who? or the family' and he said عيلتي / صديق العيلة.
He offered كلنا for 'we ate' (right -na ending, wrong stem); Amal said No, أكلنا and he took it ('that's right'). The ending is right so it is the verb's form,
She asked 'What's the days?' and he answered أيام without el-; Amal said الأيام and he repeated واحد من الأيام.
Past 'I' -t missing; Amal prompted 'إن...', he tried انبسطت؟ and she confirmed انبسطت.
Doing verb with no object; Amal asked 'a lot of what?' and he supplied projects (engine مشربية = mashaaree3); her chat writes 5allasna kteer mashaaree3.
For 'this time' (occasion) he said haadi el-wa2t (time as duration); Amal replaced it with هذي المرة, he repeated هاديل مرة and her chat writes haadi el-marra.
For 'do this / like this' he tried هادي / هادا (this) where هيك is needed; his line from 1:09:44 runs several words, so her هيك at 1:09:45 most likely came befo
After nafs he put el- on seedo, which already has a possessive ending; Amal recast نفس اسم سيده and then pointed at the idafa ('اسم سيده is what?').
Wrong form of أخ before an owner (a5u is the special construct form, not an el- rule); Amal prompted أخوه and he said أخو خطيبتي at 1:08:04.
For 'the youngest' he used the plain adjective el-sa8eer; Amal said 'don't do this', gave the superlative a2sghar ishi and added 'I think you'll pick up on this
For 'white people' he used the singular adjective el-abyad; Amal gave the broken plural beed / el-naas el-beed.
He asked how to say 'if I could'; Amal taught إذا لازم أختار / ممكن ('we don't have should, could, would') - didn't-know.
He asked which form means 'show' with made-up forms; Amal gave فرجيت / بفرجي (sheet: 'i show | Ana bafarji') and he used فرجيتك at 50:20.
Repeating her question back he put el- on shahar, the first word of the idafa shahr el-3asal; Amal gave شهر العسل and he repeated it.
His sentence was right (her chat: ra7 n5a66et el-3urus); Amal then taught the new verb 'to get married' - a didn't-know, tier 0, never a slip.
